description: Calculate TAM/SAM/SOM bottom-up from your company count, ACV, ICP match rate and Year 1 share (calculation framework, not a data source). Sector notes are added when your inputs name one of the supported sectors

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it

data_sources.description: Where you got your numbers (for documentation)

icp_percentage.description: Percentage of those companies that match your ICP, from 0 to 100. Left out, 30 is used and marked as an example

product_category.description: Optional: what you sell (for example "spend management software"), used for sector notes. The arithmetic does not use it

total_potential_companies.description: Estimated total companies that could buy (from LinkedIn, industry reports)

year1_market_share_target.description: Realistic Year 1 market share percentage, from 0 to 100 (typically 1-5%). Left out, 3 is used and marked as an example

name: tam_sam_som_calculator
title: TAM SAM SOM Calculator
